rule: GOAL: Move the floating player left to reach the yellow marker on the black bar. CONTROLS: Clicking the upper blue block lowers the upper fluid level and raises the lower level. RULE: The player’s position is tied to the lower fluid surface; raising the level moves the player left. TRAP: Assuming fluid volume is conserved; it is not, so you must manage levels independently.

GOAL: Move the purple square to the blue circle by hopping along the dotted line. CONTROLS: Click a dot to slide the square there. The plus sign marks the maximum distance. RULE: You can only move up to three steps at a time. Longer jumps are ignored. TRAP: Thinking you could click any dot. Dots beyond the plus sign are out of range and waste moves.

GOAL: Fill both yellow bucket notches with falling magenta liquid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the blue bar; spacebar releases the liquid. RULE: The bar splits the flow, sending streams off its ends. TRAP: Assuming streams fall straight down; they actually drift outward.

GOAL: Raise gray levels from the bottom chamber to the top marker. CONTROLS: Click the blue connector below the bar to pump gray upward. RULE: Each click moves four columns, requiring multiple pumps to fill capacity. TRAP: Believing one click moves the entire stack; it only shifts a small portion.

GOAL: Extend both bars until their ends touched the crosses. CONTROLS: Left and right brackets adjusted the blue bar; up and down brackets adjusted the yellow bar. RULE: The closed side of each bracket showed which way that bar would grow. TRAP: Believing the open side indicated direction caused initial clicks to shrink the bars instead.

GOAL: Navigate the player to the exit marker. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the character one tile at a time. RULE: Walls blocked movement completely, while open spaces allowed free travel. TRAP: Assuming diagonal movement or jumping over obstacles was possible, when only straight steps worked.

GOAL: Match target colors in five columns. CONTROLS: Arrows shift color cycles up or down. RULE: Each column cycles independently through seven distinct colors. TRAP: Assuming a single global sequence; columns operate in isolation.

GOAL: Insert the shrinking piston into the left notch. CONTROLS: Arrows rotated the halves and moved the tip left by its current width. RULE: Filling grid patterns halved the tip's size until it matched the notch's height. TRAP: Assuming the tip moves a fixed distance; it shifts by its own width, so smaller tips travel less per press.

GOAL: Align three horizontal bars so falling streams land exactly in three notches without spilling. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the selected bar; mouse clicks select a different bar; space triggers the flow. RULE: Streams only stop if they hit a bar’s edge; otherwise, they pass through or split around obstacles. TRAP: Moving bars left to center them caused overlaps that split streams, sending liquid into wrong notches.

GOAL: Match fluid levels in compartments 0, 3, and 4 to specific targets. CONTROLS: Clicking a column transfers two units of fluid from its neighbor into the clicked compartment. RULE: Only click when the neighboring source has at least two units of fluid remaining. TRAP: Believing markers were hard stops; they are guides, allowing reversible overshoots if you monitor the source.

GOAL: Shrink the snake's head to pass through narrow gaps. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to turn them green. RULE: Match the green cells to the dot pattern on the side panel. TRAP: Assuming the center cell is always part of the required pattern.

GOAL: Reach the exit by navigating around a moving red leaf. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the character; the leaf shifted left when approached. RULE: The leaf always moves in its facing direction, not toward you. TRAP: Believing the leaf chases you caused hesitation; it simply glides left, allowing safe passage once you understand its fixed path.

GOAL: Align four horizontal bars so each fully covers its designated stream segment. CONTROLS: Mouse selects a bar; arrow keys shift it left or right; space submits the configuration. RULE: Bars move in fixed four-unit steps, requiring precise alignment to ensure complete coverage without gaps. TRAP: Assuming the currently selected bar remains active after moving another, leading to wasted selection actions.

GOAL: Guide the green marker to the cross without touching the purple shape. CONTROLS: Left clicks shrink the green's height; right clicks grow the yellow's width. RULE: The green must be shorter than the purple's top edge before moving right. TRAP: Trying to move the green sideways while tall causes a collision and wasted steps.

GOAL: Reproduce the top color sequence in the middle slots. CONTROLS: Click a palette color to select it, then click a middle slot to place it. RULE: Each placement consumes one step from the shrinking bar. TRAP: Believing the selection persists; you must re-click the palette before every placement.

GOAL: You cleared the level by eliminating three red enemies using just eight moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved your character; moving onto an enemy destroyed it. RULE: Red enemies only activate when you approach from their facing direction. TRAP: Believing any nearby move triggers them wasted time; perpendicular approaches are safe.

ESTABLISHED: Tail length dictates which targets move with the player; currently, all three are covered. FAILED: Assuming the hollow icon reliably predicts target movement; it contradicted the tail length logic. GOAL IS NOT: Simply aligning all targets, as their independent row positions complicate the solution. CONTROLS: Left/Right changes tail length and target indices; Up/Down moves the player and covered targets.

ESTABLISHED: Yellow top sits in center column. Bottom spans three columns. Current top lights first three; bottom lights last two. FAILED: Assuming bottom aligns only to center or right columns. Previous wide-grid calculations were incorrect. GOAL IS NOT: All lights on, or symmetric patterns. It is a specific sparse arrangement, likely single-column top. CONTROLS: Clicking a light toggles it. No other buttons. Actions are limited; plan before clicking.

ESTABLISHED: The bar at row seven blocks carrying box A below it, forcing a carry on the left or top. FAILED: Trying to move A downward while carrying it below the player causes a collision with the bar. GOAL IS NOT: Symmetric mirroring of box positions across the bar’s center, as box B cannot reach the required spots. CONTROLS: Space picks up and drops adjacent items. Direction keys move the player, keeping the carried box in the relative position.

GOAL: Align six rotating dials to specific symbols. CONTROLS: Arrows move between dials; up/down rotates the current dial. RULE: Symbols cycle in a fixed order, allowing you to count steps to the target. TRAP: Assuming dials are independent; rotating one often affects neighbors or requires a specific visit order.

GOAL: Arrange colored tiles to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Click a tile to select it, then click a destination slot to swap them. Press Space to submit your solution. RULE: The animation reveals the first mismatched position, allowing you to correct errors step-by-step. TRAP: Assuming tiles move without swapping; clicking a filled slot exchanges the two tiles instead of displacing one.

GOAL: Align both cross centers to specific dots so arms cover all colored targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected cross by three units; space switches active cross. RULE: Each cross must center on a dot matching its color to complete the level. TRAP: Assuming dots move with crosses; they stay fixed while only the crosses shift.

GOAL: Fill the red track with colors from attached green and blue boxes. CONTROLS: Click palette colors to place them; press space to submit. RULE: Read slots in order, replacing ports with their attached box’s contents. TRAP: Assuming ports are fillable slots; they are connectors, not targets.

GOAL: Align the plug with the socket using switch counts. CONTROLS: Click switches to toggle states; click mouse to execute movement. RULE: Each active switch moves the plug one unit; direction depends on axis. TRAP: Assuming switch position mattered; only the total count determined distance.

GOAL: Insert the green ring into the red slot that aligns the pre-filled letter with the target sequence. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, click slots to place, press space to submit. RULE: The attached green box slots replace the red slot at the connection point, preserving the pre-filled letter's position. TRAP: Assuming the ring connects at the first red slot; the pre-filled letter dictates the only valid connection point.

GOAL: Arrange colored rings into red and blue boxes to satisfy specific color sequences. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, click slots to place, space to submit. RULE: Blue rings must form the sequence N, R, R; red slots take M, Y, p. TRAP: Assuming port order doesn't matter; incorrect port placement creates invalid color chains.

GOAL: Position the line's midpoint directly on the target ring. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move the active end; click the inactive end to swap which end moves. RULE: The level clears only when the center bead aligns perfectly with the ring's center. TRAP: Believing the line merely needs to cross the ring, rather than centering the midpoint exactly.

GOAL: Align three distinct shapes to cover all marked target dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape by three pixels; Space cycles selection. RULE: Coverage is geometric, not pixel-perfect; lines passing through dots suffice. TRAP: Assuming overlap fails the level; different shapes can intersect without penalty.

GOAL: Match target colors by placing rings to set box order and filling slots with palette colors. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, click empty slots to place, press space to verify. RULE: The ring sequence in the red box determines which colored box reads first, second, and third. TRAP: Assuming box positions are fixed; actually, the rings swap which box corresponds to which target segment.

GOAL: Guide the yellow tile to the selector. CONTROLS: Red arrows shift tiles backward; green arrows shift them forward. RULE: Each click moves the entire loop one position. TRAP: Ignoring the yellow highlight and guessing a different target wastes moves.

GOAL: Align three shapes—line, X, diamond—to target dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape; Space selects the next shape. RULE: Only one shape moves at a time; selection cycles through all three. TRAP: Assuming the line was fully centered when it passed through a target dot, ignoring its actual center position.

GOAL: Move the square to the purple ring. CONTROLS: Click an arm to activate it; click a destination to move the square to the midpoint of the arms. RULE: Only the square’s final position matters; arms may cross blue zones freely. TRAP: Assuming arms block moves when crossing blue regions cost time, as only the square’s location is restricted.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single peg by capturing pieces. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click the landing spot to jump over its neighbor. RULE: A jump is valid only if the landing square is empty; the jumped piece is removed. TRAP: Assuming any adjacent empty space works; you must jump exactly two squares, not one.

GOAL: Guide the player into the marked box. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player through the pipes. RULE: The box glyph shows the required orientation upon entry. TRAP: Thinking the box was a barrier rather than the destination.

GOAL: Make the bottom-right panel's outer grid match its legend. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to toggle their color. RULE: White in the legend means the cell should be red. TRAP: Assuming the legend updates dynamically as you click; it does not.

GOAL: Turn specific grid cells orange to match the legend's pattern. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell toggles its color; clicking the legend sets the target color. RULE: The legend acts as a stencil, mapping its colors to the grid's neighborhood. TRAP: Assuming the legend tiles themselves needed changing; they are static indicators, not targets.

GOAL: Guide both yellow tiles to their matching green targets. CONTROLS: Rotate rows horizontally; cycle the central vertical column. RULE: Tiles move independently; rotating a row affects all tiles in it, including intersections. TRAP: Assuming tiles stay in their starting row. They must cross via the center column, so plan moves that shift them between rows rather than just sliding them sideways.

GOAL: Turn all red tiles orange to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Click a tile to cycle its color; the legend shows the mapping. RULE: The legend center indicates which source color becomes the target color, not the tile’s current state. TRAP: Believing legend centers show current status; they are static keys, so clicking them breaks the mapping.

GOAL: Change shape colors by touching matching boxes, then position them to cover their colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape; Space switches between the X and the plus. RULE: Touching a box immediately updates the shape’s color to match it. TRAP: Moving directly through a different color box ruins the plan; route around obstacles to preserve the target hue.

ESTABLISHED: Two blue figures swap positions between boxes. Moving up leads to a branching path ending in a top bar. FAILED: Stopping at the neck junctions or the bottom row does not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Meeting in the middle or staying in the starting boxes. CONTROLS: Up moves both figures upward. Left and right shift them horizontally along paths.

GOAL: Place both blue markers at the opposite ends of the top horizontal bar. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active marker; the other marker mirrors movement in the opposite direction. RULE: Moving one piece forces the other to move away, requiring you to push them apart to reach distant targets. TRAP: Assuming the markers move independently; they are linked, so pulling one back pushes the other forward.

GOAL: Move the yellow tile to its bracket and the orange tile to its bracket. CONTROLS: The left arrow rotates the left ring; the right arrow rotates the right ring. RULE: The shared slot connects both rings, so a rotation on one side shifts tiles on the other. TRAP: Treating the rings as independent systems leads to wasted clicks, as each move affects the entire configuration.

GOAL: Route the green token through the red wire to reach the yellow box. CONTROLS: Arrows move the token; clicks rotate the red wire segments. RULE: The token stops at broken checkerboard sections, requiring rotation to connect paths. TRAP: Believing the right panel’s plugs were movable pieces rather than static reference shapes.

GOAL: Decode color shades using overlapping legends to fill the grid. CONTROLS: Click tiles to cycle through blue, red, and orange colors. RULE: White always means the legend's center color; gray means the other shared color. TRAP: Assuming gray maps to different colors in different legends. Consistency across overlaps was the key.

ESTABLISHED: Two beads sit on a line with a gap between them. Pressing right moves one bead into the gap; the other stays put. The active bead is marked with a white dot. FAILED: Moving the wrong bead, or moving twice without checking which one is active, wastes time and does not solve the puzzle. GOAL IS NOT: To make the beads touch each other or to align them perfectly with the screen edges. CONTROLS: Right moves the active bead. The white dot indicates which bead is currently active.

ESTABLISHED: Blue reaches the terminal. Pressing space there resets blue and extends the red plug; no ghost appears. FAILED: Committing recordings that end at the terminal. Ghosts only appear if blue moves after committing elsewhere. GOAL IS NOT: Leaving the ghost at the terminal. The ghost must exist while blue moves away. CONTROLS: Arrows move blue. Space commits the recording if blue is not at the terminal.

GOAL: Rotate the plug to face the socket and slide it in to connect the red prongs. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the plug; SPACE rotated it clockwise. RULE: Red parts must align perfectly to form a continuous path. TRAP: Assuming prongs should overlap contacts instead of sitting adjacent to them.

GOAL: Record a path ending on the terminal, then replay it to keep the plug retracted while traversing the gap. CONTROLS: Arrows move the character. Space toggles recording and playback modes. RULE: The plug retracts only while the ghost occupies the terminal; it stays retracted if the recording ends there. TRAP: Believing the plug retracts immediately upon recording; it only retracts during playback when the ghost reaches the terminal.

GOAL: Align the mirrored shapes with the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrows move the pair; each press shifts three units. RULE: The dark shape must cover the yellow spot exactly. TRAP: Assuming rotation was needed; only translation matters here.

GOAL: Guide the token from the start to the yellow goal box. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the token two spaces per press. RULE: The path is valid only if the token stays on connected colored bars. TRAP: Do not assume diagonal adjacency connects bars; only side-to-side contact works.

GOAL: Transform the grid to match the target pattern defined by the overlapping legends. CONTROLS: Click switches to toggle global modes; click tiles to flip their color state. RULE: Legend mapping depends on the center color; white maps to the center's shade, while the other shade maps to the opposite. TRAP: Assuming the color mapping is constant; it actually shifts based on which legend is active, requiring careful mode alignment.

GOAL: Reach the socket after clearing two blocking plugs. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; spacebar records and replays ghost moves. RULE: Ghosts must trigger switches to retract plugs before the player passes. TRAP: Moving the player before ghosts clear the path causes collisions.

GOAL: Move the yellow tile to the yellow bracket and the orange tile to the orange bracket. CONTROLS: Red arrows shift the horizontal rows; green arrows shift the vertical columns. RULE: Each arrow rotates its respective line by one position, carrying all tiles along. TRAP: Assuming arrows move only single tiles; they actually shift the entire row or column.

GOAL: Move the charcoal block to cover the yellow target zone in the left panel. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the active piece; the charcoal moves opposite the black block. RULE: The charcoal mirrors the black block's position across the central line. TRAP: Thinking the line moves independently; it stays fixed while pieces swap sides.

GOAL: Rotate seven tiles to align their classes with a shared cycle order. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selector; Up and Down rotated the current tile’s class. RULE: Each tile’s rotation offset was independent of its class sequence position. TRAP: Assuming uniform rotation offsets across all tiles led to wasted moves correcting individual mismatches.

GOAL: Move yellow tiles into yellow brackets. CONTROLS: Red arrows rotate tiles clockwise; green arrows rotate counter-clockwise. RULE: The middle arrow shifts all tiles along a single long path; the top arrow only shifts the vertical column. TRAP: Assuming the top arrow affects the whole top row; it only moves the five tiles in the leftmost column.

GOAL: Reach the exit while dodging a bouncing orange guard and destroying a red laser. CONTROLS: Arrows move you; moving onto the red target destroys it. RULE: Time your steps so your paths never intersect the orange’s oscillation. TRAP: Moving immediately wastes time; wait a turn to shift parity and slip past the guard safely.

GOAL: Paint the lower diagonal band purple using the applicator's three dip positions. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the applicator; clicks selected colors; space dipped to paint the current band. RULE: Each dip position paints a distinct diagonal stripe; overlapping them covers the target area. TRAP: Assuming a single dip covers the whole band; you must combine multiple dips to fill the gaps.

ESTABLISHED: The camera locks to the plug, keeping it at screen rows 37-41 while the world scrolls. Moving up shifts the channel and top room down by 18 rows. FAILED: Assuming the plug stays at fixed world coordinates or that the channel moves independently of the camera scroll. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the top room without aligning the plug with the cross structure. CONTROLS: Up moves the plug and scrolls the world. Left and Right shift the plug horizontally.

GOAL: Guide the plug through the channel to the cross socket in the upper room. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug; it automatically slides up to hug the ceiling after each move. RULE: The plug always rises to the highest open space, allowing it to pass through the barrier's channel. TRAP: Believing you must manually steer the plug up; instead, position it under the channel and let gravity do the work.

GOAL: Move three yellow tiles to specific slots using rotation arrows. CONTROLS: E rotates tiles outward; S rotates them clockwise around the center. RULE: Each arrow moves all tiles on that ring simultaneously; individual tiles cannot be isolated. TRAP: Assuming S moves tiles counter-clockwise wasted time; it actually rotates them clockwise, reversing the required sequence.

GOAL: Connect the pulse to the pink socket to clear the corridor and reach the blue head. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the tip; rotation changes step length. RULE: The pulse must reach the pink socket to destroy dark red blocks. TRAP: Assuming any pulse connection works; only the pink socket clears obstacles.

GOAL: Relocate three puzzle ends to specific target squares to satisfy a strict coordinate sum constraint. CONTROLS: Click an end, then click a destination square to move it there. RULE: The sum of all target coordinates must equal the required total; only specific combinations work. TRAP: Assuming any valid-looking square was acceptable; intermediate moves required precise footprint validation, blocking obvious paths.

GOAL: Align four independent bouncing particles to merge at a single coordinate. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the entire particle system left, right, up, or down. RULE: Each particle moves in a fixed line with a unique speed and bounce range. TRAP: Assuming particles interact or share paths wastes time; they are independent entities that merely coincide.

GOAL: Place both yellow tiles into the designated bracket slots. CONTROLS: Green buttons cycle the row and group together; red buttons reverse this. Top/bottom buttons shift tiles through the vertical column. RULE: The corner tile belongs to both the row and column cycles, allowing you to move items between horizontal and vertical paths. TRAP: Assuming the column and row are independent. They share the corner, so moving one affects the other.

GOAL: Guide two dots down mirrored paths to meet in the central passage. CONTROLS: Arrows move both dots simultaneously; left and right are swapped for the second dot. RULE: They win by merging into a single unit at the divider’s center. TRAP: Assuming you can park one dot alone to adjust spacing is impossible; both always move.

GOAL: Rotate the glyph to match the target shape. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the pattern clockwise or counter-clockwise. RULE: Only the rotation matching the reference image counts as correct. TRAP: Assuming standard matrix rotation; the game uses a specific custom mapping that differs from manual calculation.

GOAL: Guide three colored squares to matching rings using only two moves. CONTROLS: Click a square to select it, then click a ring to move it there. RULE: Squares lock onto rings only when their colors align perfectly with the ring's pattern. TRAP: Assuming you must navigate through intermediate rings; direct jumps work if colors match, saving crucial actions.

GOAL: Route the pink marker to its cross by shifting the orange bar past the purple obstacle. CONTROLS: Clicking the orange bar moves it right; clicking the green bar expands it vertically. RULE: The purple block is immovable, but the white vertical can slide right if its rows don't overlap the purple. TRAP: Believing the white vertical was permanently blocked by the purple; it only blocks when their rows intersect.

GOAL: Route a token around a compass to dip three colors, isolating the white triangle from the orange field. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the token along a directed cycle; space dipped the active color; clicks selected the next color. RULE: Movement was strictly one-way along the compass path, requiring a long detour to return to the starting position. TRAP: Assuming movement was reversible cost time; the path from East to North was longer than the return trip.

GOAL: Clear the level in three actions by moving the cursor to the target. CONTROLS: The three arrows move the cursor one step in their respective directions. RULE: Only the final position counts; intermediate moves do not trigger a win condition. TRAP: Assuming each move costs resources or time; here, speed is irrelevant, only precision matters.

ESTABLISHED: Three lanes hold Y markers at offsets 8, 7, and 3. Diagonal arrows rotate specific segments without moving the Ys. Bottom arrow advances all lanes. FAILED: Clicking bottom arrow five times did not confirm if markers stop at brackets or wrap around. GOAL IS NOT: Aligning all markers simultaneously via simple rotation, as lane lengths differ. CONTROLS: Diagonal arrows adjust segment phases; bottom arrow increments lane position.

GOAL: Route three distinct lines to their matching colored endpoints without crossing or overlapping paths. CONTROLS: Click a line to select it, then click a destination square to extend that line to that spot. RULE: Only the currently selected line moves; unselected lines remain fixed, preventing accidental displacement of completed segments. TRAP: Believing you can move multiple lines at once wastes turns; switching selection requires a separate click, doubling the action count.

GOAL: Arrange five colored bars into a specific non-overlapping pattern. CONTROLS: Side arrows on each color panel expand or shrink that bar’s length. RULE: Bar position is fixed; only length changes to clear gaps and avoid collisions. TRAP: Assuming bars slide. They do not. You must adjust lengths to fit, not move them.

GOAL: The level required arranging colors so a sequential walk through nested boxes matched the target pattern. CONTROLS: Clicking two slots swapped their contents. Space confirmed the solution. RULE: Reading order was positional, not fixed; rings passed the reading cursor to their attached boxes, shifting subsequent indices. TRAP: Assuming slots held absolute positions wasted time; the cursor advanced past every emitted color, making index tracking essential.

GOAL: Rotate the grid to align a target with the exit before moving the block. CONTROLS: Arrows move the character; a separate button rotates the entire world. RULE: The world rotates around a fixed center, changing your relative path to the goal. TRAP: Thinking you must rotate before moving; often, moving first creates a shorter path after rotation.

ESTABLISHED: The green piece is already moved; four colored pieces exist with specific pin counts. FAILED: Assuming every pin must be paired or that pieces must form a single merged block. GOAL IS NOT: Using all twelve pins or creating one solid fused object. CONTROLS: Arrows shift position; SPACE rotates or adjusts alignment; pins connect when overlapping.

GOAL: Align pieces and line to meet reflection targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move pieces or line; Space selects active object. RULE: Pieces and line must satisfy reflection symmetry simultaneously. TRAP: Moving pieces before the line wastes actions; set the line first.

GOAL: Fill the grid by applying four colors via three dips and one stamp. CONTROLS: Arrows move the applicator; clicks select colors or trigger the reservoir; space dips. RULE: Three dips covering all regions overwrite previous colors, making the initial state irrelevant. TRAP: Believing the existing orange stamp persists; it is erased by the final purple dip.

GOAL: Fill the yellow rectangle by stamping the correct color. CONTROLS: Click to select colors, move the tool, and press to apply stamps. RULE: Stamps rotate with the tool’s position; match the orientation to the target shape. TRAP: Assuming the stamp stays upright regardless of where you move the tool.

GOAL: Align three separate shapes to match yellow reference outlines. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space cycles to the next piece. RULE: The horizontal mirror line must sit exactly halfway between the original and its reflection. TRAP: Assuming the line position was arbitrary; misplacing it caused reflections to miss their targets entirely.

GOAL: Guide the player to the yellow socket before the timer expires. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; ghosts replay your previous movements exactly. RULE: Ghosts retract from plugs only when they reach their recorded end position. TRAP: Believing a ghost is missing when it is actually hidden beneath your player.

GOAL: Guide two agents to a shared destination by relocating three sliding gates to clear their paths. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected gate; clicking a gate selects it for movement. RULE: Both agents move simultaneously with each key press, requiring synchronized planning to avoid collisions. TRAP: Assuming standard grid directions applies; vertical movement shifts rows, not columns, confusing spatial orientation.

GOAL: Position mirror lines so the diagonal reflection covers the yellow target area. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected line; Space cycles selection between the piece, horizontal line, and vertical line. RULE: Only the diagonal reflection needed to align with the yellow shape; other reflections could overlap empty space. TRAP: Believing all reflections must match the yellow exactly. Extra overlaps were allowed, so only the diagonal alignment mattered.

ESTABLISHED: Token moves only on gray paths. Yellow box is the goal. Pinwheel flip changes path colors but not connectivity to yellow. FAILED: Entering yellow from purple, blue, or gray. Moving onto checkers. Using remaining actions to probe blue path. GOAL IS NOT: A checker, pinwheel, or hidden panel button. CONTROLS: Arrows move token. Pinwheel button flips colors. Panel buttons are inert without plugs.

ESTABLISHED: Yellow spawns at rows 25-28, cols 31-34, covering the circle's center. Pink merges occur when a moving piece lands adjacent to a stationary one. Purple pieces do not interact with pinks. FAILED: The planned 13-move sequence did not clear the level. Specific mid-sequence deviations or unexpected states halted progress before completion. GOAL IS NOT: Simply forming the yellow piece at the center. The level remains active despite correct yellow placement. CONTROLS: Clicking spawns pieces. Moving a piece adjacent to another of the same color merges them. Clicks on empty space move the

GOAL: Paint the canvas blue, the east band green, and the southeast band orange, then stamp red at the north. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your marker; number keys select paint colors; the spacebar applies paint or stamps. RULE: The final dip covering a cell determines its color, so paint the largest area last to avoid overwriting. TRAP: Assuming selected colors persist between turns; you must explicitly reselect the paint color before every dip.

ESTABLISHED: Bars emit from the opposite half of the hit. Middle hits emit both exits. FAILED: Filling two notches did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply filling any two notches. CONTROLS: Hits determine exit sides based on the half-rule.

ESTABLISHED: Pair 2 moves left one step per position. Pair 1 moves down. Positions affect distinct frames. FAILED: Testing individual states in isolation. Letting the timer expire without data. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching endpoint coordinates; the path may matter. CONTROLS: Flips set binary states (up/down, left/right). Click executes the sequence.

GOAL: Merge two purple blocks into one yellow block. CONTROLS: Click a block to select it; click a target space to move it there. RULE: Blocks merge only when adjacent, not when overlapping or touching corners. TRAP: Believing you must move both blocks to the exact same coordinate; they must stop adjacent to trigger the merge.

GOAL: Reach the box with zero fuel. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player. RULE: Passing the prism cycles your color; matching the gate’s color allows entry. TRAP: Assuming the prism is a one-time switch. It stays active, so avoid crossing it again or you will change color unexpectedly.

GOAL: Place two scattered pieces onto a yellow target band using reflection. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; SPACE cycles selection between pieces and lines. RULE: Pieces reflect across the horizontal and vertical center lines, so moving one aligns its mirror image. TRAP: Assuming the selection order is fixed; always check which piece is active before moving to avoid wasting actions.

ESTABLISHED: The plug is trapped below green blocks at columns 49-53. Only green blocks are removable; black areas are permanent barriers. FAILED: Moving the plug left to column 33 leads to a dead end blocked by black walls at row 6. GOAL IS NOT: Finding a horizontal path through the black region at rows 12-18. CONTROLS: Clicking green blocks removes them. The plug automatically climbs upward through cleared vertical passages.

GOAL: Position two ghosts to retract red and purple plugs, allowing safe passage to the observation point. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player and ghosts; Space commits ghost positions. RULE: Plugs retract only when ghosts reach specific target tiles, opening paths for the player. TRAP: Assuming static walkability; paths are blocked until ghosts complete their movements.

GOAL: Move two beads through a wall to land in distant rings. CONTROLS: Arrows slide beads; clicks select the active bead. RULE: Pushing a bead against the wall launches it fifteen units into the opposite panel. TRAP: Assuming beads stay on their wire or that walls block movement entirely.

GOAL: Guide the player upward through channels by balancing water levels. CONTROLS: Click arrows to shift water between adjacent channels; click windows to move the player. RULE: Water flows to equalize; the player floats to the surface of their current channel. TRAP: Believing higher numbers mean more water. Higher numbers indicate emptier channels, causing the player to sink.

ESTABLISHED: Three jumps cleared region A to one peg at column 44, with the plug at column 50, yet no win occurred. FAILED: Clicking to jump to column 56 produced no target indicator; achieving one peg in region A with the plug at the end did not trigger victory. GOAL IS NOT: Simply having one peg in region A, nor having the plug at the end while one peg remains in A. CONTROLS: Clicking a peg executes a jump if the geometry allows; clicking the gray key resets the board; undo reverses the last action.

GOAL: Merge pairs into purples, then purples into yellow, covering the target. CONTROLS: Click empty cells to move pieces; click near pieces to merge them. RULE: Pieces merge when their centers are within a distance of roughly nine. TRAP: Assuming diagonal alignment is required; merges occur regardless of angle if close enough.

GOAL: Lift the plug to the ceiling by clearing the path above it. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the plug sideways; clicks removed blocking green bricks. RULE: The plug rises automatically to the highest available space once obstacles are gone. TRAP: Believing the cross’s black outline was a solid barrier that would stop the plug’s ascent.

ESTABLISHED: The orange shape covers two dots after moving left. The third orange dot remains uncovered. FAILED: Moving the shape left did not cover all orange dots. GOAL IS NOT: Covering every orange dot with the orange shape alone. CONTROLS: Left moves the shape. Right, up, and down also move it.

GOAL: Move four blocks to matching holes. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected block. Click selects a block. RULE: A block pushes another if they touch and move together. TRAP: Thinking you can move blocks independently. Pushes chain, wasting actions if unplanned.

GOAL: Guide the token to the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrows move the token. Clicking the purple button solidifies purple wires. RULE: Solid wires create a continuous path for the token to travel. TRAP: Assuming the purple button only changes appearance, not connectivity, delays finding the route.

GOAL: Move the peg to the other grid by riding the plug along the wire. CONTROLS: Click the peg to jump, or drag the plug to transport it. RULE: The plug acts as a bridge; pegs land on it and travel with it. TRAP: Thinking the plug is an obstacle. It is the only path across.

GOAL: Align three boxes inside the bar's cells to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; Space picks up or drops a box. RULE: Dropping a box restores the player's facing direction from before pickup. TRAP: Believing facing persists after dropping; it reverts, altering subsequent movement logic.
